LanguageData.ARIO_WDLevyNotPermanent: House militia, the appointed Maester, diplomatic wards and people reserved for diplomatic exchanges or trials cannot staff World Domination outposts. Move them away before founding an outpost; use ordinary caravans for their agreed travel.
LanguageData.ARIO_WDLevyPodsReturned: These transporters carried temporary House militia, the appointed Maester or diplomatic wards. Their passengers and cargo formed a caravan instead of entering a World Domination outpost.
